title: MemoryRecordsCreateRequest
description: Direct authored write bypassing capture/review. captured_by / captured_at are always provider-populated from the authenticated context and are never client-supplied (§6.6). Grant: records_write covering the declared placement. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

kind.description: Open record-kind vocabulary. Core (documented, not enforced): event, fact, note.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
